label: Mould, baby coughing
text: There's black mould spreading across the wall behind my daughter's cot. She's 8 months old and has had a cough for two weeks that the GP thinks could be linked. I've tried bleach but it comes straight back.

label: Sparking socket
text: the socket by the kettle sparked and made a bang this morning, there's a black scorch mark round it now. I've switched it off at the fuse box but we've got no power in the kitchen

label: Loose stair rail
text: The handrail on our stairs has come away from the wall at the top, it moves about two inches when you hold it. My mum is 79 and uses the stairs every day.

label: Draughty window
text: Hi, the bedroom window doesn't close properly and there's a draught coming in at night. The heating works fine and the rest of the flat is warm, it's just that one room getting a bit chilly.

label: Rent query
text: Can you tell me when my rent increase starts and whether I need to change my direct debit? Thanks.

label: Vague report
text: something's not right with the flat, can someone come and have a look
